content.question: What are ensemble methods?
options: Methods that combine several models to improve predictive performance over any single model, leveraging the crowd wisdom phenomenon.
Methods that train a single model repeatedly on the entire dataset until convergence.
Methods that reduce the number of features before model training.
Methods that split the data into folds for model evaluation.
content.answer: Methods that combine several models to improve predictive performance over any single model, leveraging the crowd wisdom phenomenon.
